text: 🇲🇽🏥 Tabasco is getting 463 free doctor's offices, in every single municipality. "Sometimes you get sick and either you go to a private doctor who charges you, or to the pharmacy doctors, and then you have to buy the medicine, or you go straight to the health center or the hospital, and what you have isn't necessarily serious… So we decided to build first-contact health care." — Presidenta Claudia Sheinbaum, Honesty and Results, Villahermosa, Tabasco Each office will have a small pharmacy with the most important medicines. They are built this year and open next year, totally free. The 93-bed Cárdenas hospital, abandoned for years, is about to open, and a new 260-bed IMSS hospital in Villahermosa will serve the whole population. Tabasco receives 20,610 million pesos a year in well-being programs, plus nearly 30,000 million in infrastructure.

🇲🇽🛢️ <u>IF TRUMP BANS DIESEL EXPORTS, MEXICO HAS 13 DAYS</u>

Mexico burns about 400,000 barrels of diesel a day and imports 30–50% of it. With no strategic fuel stockpile, Pemex and private storage cover roughly 13 days of demand if Washington goes ahead with a 90-day export ban, El Financiero reports. Pemex owns Deer Park in Houston — but the refinery answers to US law, not Mexico's.

🔥🇲🇽 <u>THE "1,600 BABY TEETH" GRAVE NO ONE CAN FIND</u>

Michoacán's State Prosecutor says it has "no knowledge nor any record" of an intervention involving a clandestine grave with 1,600 children's teeth in Zacapu — and federal prosecutors have none either. No complaint or forensic request of that kind has been logged since 2021. The claim, launched in a Milenio column, was amplified by PRI chief Alejandro Moreno and a lineup of opposition commentators before anyone checked.
